question.text: Units held in a mutual fund or another investment corporation are valued using:

answer.text: Last NAV published by the scheme's manager on the Valuation Day

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.1, units in MFs/investment corporations are valued at last published NAV on Valuation Day. The Trap: Other methods don't reflect current fair value. Cross-Exam Context: Standard cross-fund valuation approach. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Verify NAV date/timestamp for unit-valuation consistency.
